item.title: Meesho reports wider losses despite 31% topline growth in Q3
item.description: Meesho’s maiden quarterly report as a public entity reveals a dual narrative: significant revenue expansion, alongside a sharp spike in losses. This comes as it focuses on long-term cash flow and further scaling Valmo.

item.title: Zupee cuts about 200 jobs in second layoff after money-gaming ban
item.description: The latest reductions, announced on Friday, affect multiple teams and form part of what the company described as a limited organisational realignment to adapt to the evolving regulatory and market environment.

item.title: [Weekly funding roundup Jan 24-30] Venture capital inflow sees sharp dip
item.description: The month of January ended on a disappointing note as the last week saw a sharp decline in venture capital funding, primarily due to a lower number of deals.

item.title: Healthians Founder Deepak Sahni transitions from diagnostic pioneer to startup mentor
item.description: With a Rs 100 crore commitment, Healthians Founder Deepak Sahni is shifting focus from scaling companies to enabling founders solving India’s most structural problems. item.title: Edge computing explained: What it means for everyday users
item.description: Tired of slow apps and laggy devices? Find out about edge computing and how it makes everyday technology faster, cheaper, and more reliable.

item.title: How a global 3D startup took shape far from India’s usual tech hubs
item.description: From a personal tragedy to global recognition, Harsha Pedeka’s 3D startup shows how innovation can emerge from Assam. Backed by state support and driven by emotion, his journey reflects the Northeast’s growing place in India’s startup story.

item.title: Aerospace manufacturer JJG Aero raises $30M in Series B round from Norwest
item.description: JJG Aero, which serves marquee clients including Collins Aerospace, Safran, and GE Aerospace, has grown at a 35% CAGR over the past three years and plans to use the funds for capacity addition and vertical integration.

item.title: Rest or avoidance? How to differentiate between the two
item.description: Rest can heal, but avoidance delays growth. Learn how to tell the difference between healthy rest and avoiding emotions you need to face.

item.title: How Propelld is rebuilding education lending in India
item.description: In this episode of the Prime Venture Partners Podcast, Victor Senapaty, Co-founder and CEO of Propelld, discusses how the company is reshaping education financing in India, having disbursed Rs 4,000 crore to over 400,000 students.

item.title: Can't afford a full-time CTO? This startup offers tech leadership on subscription
item.description: Bengaluru startup Profound IQ solves the technical leadership gap for early-stage startups through fractional CTO services.
